continuity: Tang Sadok is the current Family Head of the Sichuan Tang Clan and refuses direct aid in treating Jeok Cheongang because the clan is mobilized against those responsible for Tang Taesang’s murder.
Poison King Tang Taesang, Tang Sadok’s father and the former Family Head, is dead; his body was found with none of his limbs intact.
The unidentified middle-aged man who killed Tang Taesang survived severe poison exposure by amputating his left forearm, but his identity and unfinished objective remain unknown.
The Sichuan Tang Clan will provide Taekyung’s party only several guides to the Qingcheng Sect and Emei Sect while withholding further assistance.
Taekyung’s party remains inside the Sichuan Tang Clan’s Family Head’s Hall, and the clan’s heightened defenses and weapons preparations are responses to Tang Taesang’s death.
Jeok Cheongang remains unconscious and has at most roughly half a year to live without treatment; the Divine Physician remains the party’s best hope.
plot: Jin Taekyung presents Mae Jonghak’s letter to Tang Sadok, who learns that Jin Baekyang has died and reads the Sword Saint’s account of Jeok Cheongang’s condition and the search for the Divine Physician.

Tang Sadok refuses to let Taekyung meet Poison King Tang Taesang or provide direct assistance, offering only guides to the Qingcheng Sect and Emei Sect. Cheongpung appeals to human compassion, while Taekyung warns that refusing help will establish an unpleasant debt of gratitude and grudges between him and the Sichuan Tang Clan.

Tang Sadok reveals that the Sichuan Tang Clan’s emergency mobilization is a response to Tang Taesang’s murder. An unidentified middle-aged man is shown after killing Tang Taesang; poison remains in one arm, which he amputates before leaving the cave.
translation_decisions: Render 당사독 as Tang Sadok and 만독수라 as Myriad-Poison Asura.
Render 당사문 as Tang Taesang, while retaining 독왕 as Poison King.
Render 인의 as human compassion in Cheongpung’s appeal.
Retain Great Hero for 대협, Senior Jeok for 적 선배, and Family Head for 가주.

active_continuity: Jin Taekyung’s party is inside the Sichuan Tang Clan’s Family Head’s Hall after entering the fortified compound and surrendering their weapons.
Tang Sadok is the current Family Head of the Sichuan Tang Clan; he knows Tang Taesang’s location but refuses to arrange a meeting or provide direct medical assistance.
Tang Taesang, the former Family Head and Poison King, was murdered before the current scene; the Tang Clan is mobilizing against those responsible.
An unidentified middle-aged man killed Tang Taesang, survived the Poison King’s poison by amputating his left forearm, and escaped; his identity and objective are unresolved.
The Sichuan Tang Clan will provide only guides to the Qingcheng Sect and Emei Sect while withholding further aid.
Jeok Cheongang remains unconscious and steadily weakening, with at most roughly half a year remaining without treatment.
The Divine Physician remains unidentified and is believed to be somewhere in Sichuan; finding the physician is still the party’s primary objective.
Taekyung possesses the Thousand-Year Snow Ginseng.
Mungyeong is a capable and compassionate medical apprentice traveling with Taekyung’s party while seeking treatment for Jeok Cheongang.
Ju Hwaran remains the Yongbong Escort Bureau’s Young Bureau Head and is investigating the bureau’s traitors.
Song Ilseom will remain for one month to help Ju Hwaran purge the bureau’s traitors before seeking an elixir for Ju Hogun in Xianyang.
open_questions: Who was the middle-aged man who killed Tang Taesang, and what unfinished objective was he pursuing?
Can the Sichuan Tang Clan identify and destroy the culprits behind Tang Taesang’s murder?
Can the Divine Physician treat Jeok Cheongang before his remaining time expires, and will the Qingcheng Sect or Emei Sect provide useful assistance?
Which other Yongbong Escort Bureau members collaborated with Heo Jun, and how will the Zhongnan Sect’s leaders and wider organizers respond?
Who sought the Guangdong Chen Family’s Peak martial arts, and what happened to the family’s other members?
temporary_decisions: Render 선화아 as Ship-Fire Boy and retain Mu Song for 무송.
Render 사천당문 as Sichuan Tang Clan and 당가 as Tang Family when the source distinguishes the forms.
Render 공자님 as Young Master when Mungyeong addresses Taekyung.
Render 노야 as Old Master in Taekyung’s private address for Jeok Cheongang.

names.notes: Current Family Head of the Sichuan Tang Clan; also called the Myriad-Poison Asura.
Former Family Head of the Sichuan Tang Clan and Poison King; Tang Sadok’s father.

profile_creations.personality: Grim, cold, blunt, suspicious, and unsentimental, with fierce concern for the Tang Clan’s affairs.
profile_creations.relationships: Tang Taesang was his father and predecessor as Family Head; he knows Jeok Cheongang as Senior Jeok and refuses Jin Taekyung’s request for direct aid while the Tang Clan pursues his father’s killers.
profile_creations.role: Current Family Head of the Sichuan Tang Clan and son of Poison King Tang Taesang, responsible for directing the clan’s response to his father’s murder.

profile_creations.relationships: Tang Sadok was his only child and successor as Family Head; his murder has placed the Sichuan Tang Clan on a campaign against the unidentified perpetrators.
profile_creations.role: Former Family Head of the Sichuan Tang Clan and Supreme Peak master once renowned as the world’s greatest authority on poison and hidden weapons; he was murdered before the current events.
